BULK_RUNNING_NOTE: {n} running game(s) are skipped — the rest are applied
QAM_ABOUT: Each profile button targets only games with that profile saved.
QAM_ABOUT_GUIDE: You can save each game's graphics settings from [Apply / save per game].
OPEN_DISCOVER_DESC: Finds graphics settings files in your installed games and registers them
OPEN_GAMES_DESC: Saves profiles per game and applies them one game at a time
POPUP_DISCOVER_MODAL_FAILED: Could not open the “Detect games” screen — nothing was changed
POPUP_GAMES_MODAL_FAILED: Could not open the “Apply / save per game” screen — nothing was changed
POPUP_SETTINGS_MODAL_FAILED: Could not open the “Settings” screen — nothing was changed
NO_GAMES: No games are registered — you can add them from [Detect games]
UI_CHECK_FAILED: Some UI components were not found ({missing}) — toggle the plugin off and on to retry. If it persists, the cause is recorded in the plugin log under Decky settings.
APPLY_ALL_STOPPED: Applying {profile} stopped partway through — some games may already have been switched
APPLY_PROBLEM_REFUSED: {names} — running, so nothing was applied there; close them and try again
SAVE_CONFIRM_BODY: This overwrites what was previously saved in this profile.
SAVE_CONFIRM_INCOMING: Will be saved:  the game's current config file — {state}
SAVE_CONFIRM_BACKUP_LIMIT: A backup is created only if the previous profile file can be read. Any backup created may drop off the list after roughly {n} more applies for this game.
DISK_STATE_UNKNOWN: different from every profile (looks like it was changed in-game)
DISK_STATE_LOOKUP_FAILED: the config file could not be read
SAVE_CONFIRM_MODAL_FAILED: Could not open the confirmation dialog — nothing was saved.
PATH_IS_SYMLINK: The config path is a symbolic link, so it was refused for safety
PATH_OUTSIDE_PREFIX: The config file is outside this game's Proton prefix — only files inside …/steamapps/compatdata/<appid>/pfx/… can be registered
PATH_OUTSIDE_HOME: This game's Proton prefix was not found and the file is outside your home folder
NOT_REGULAR_FILE: That path is not a regular file
FILE_EMPTY: The config file is empty (0 bytes)
SIZE_OUT_OF_RANGE: The config file's size differs too much from when the profile was saved, so nothing was changed — a game update may have restructured it. Check your settings in-game, then save the profile again to refresh the baseline.
LINE_COUNT_OUT_OF_RANGE: The config file's line count differs too much from when the profile was saved, so nothing was changed — a game update may have restructured it. Check your settings in-game, then save the profile again to refresh the baseline.
CONFIG_MISSING: The game's config file does not exist. Running the game and opening its graphics settings may create it. If it still does not appear, first unregister this game in [Apply / save per game], then pick the file again in [Detect games].
PROFILE_MISSING: This profile has not been saved yet
PROFILE_CORRUPT: This saved profile doesn't match its records and may be damaged — save the profile again for this game, or bring back an earlier version from [Restore backup].
GAME_RUNNING: The game is running; close it completely and try again
BACKUP_FAILED: The operation stopped because the backup failed. The game's settings file is unchanged.
REGISTRY_UNREADABLE: The plugin's game list could not be read. Toggle the plugin off and on, then please try again. If this continues, the game-list file may be damaged. Profiles and backups were not changed.
REGISTRY_MALFORMED: The plugin's game list has an invalid format. Profiles and backups were not changed.
REGISTRY_NEWER: This plugin is older than the version that created its data. Changing actions are stopped to protect the data — install the newer version to continue where you left off, or use [Full reset] to start over on this version. Profiles and backups were not changed.
SAV_REFUSED: Files with a “.sav” extension and files inside a folder named “savegames” cannot be registered (case-insensitive).
STALE_COPY_REFUSED: That file is an old copy inside a backup folder
ENGINE_BOILERPLATE_REFUSED: That is a game engine's internal file, not a settings file
RESERVED_NAME_REFUSED: This file name is one the plugin already uses inside its profile folder, so it cannot be registered — please pick a different file.
BACKUP_OUT_OF_ROOT: This game's profile or backup data path is not in its expected location.
DELETE_FAILED: Unregistering could not be completed. Some or all profile data may already have been deleted.
BACKUP_ID_INVALID: That backup id is not valid
PROFILE_META_CORRUPT: The profile information could not be read
PROFILE_WRITE_FAILED: Could not save the profile — check free space and file permissions
ALREADY_REGISTERED: This game is already registered — remove it first if you need to point it at a different file
UNEXPECTED: Unexpected error — please try again. If it persists, the cause is recorded in the plugin log under Decky settings.
WARN_OUTSIDE_SCAN_ROOTS: This file is outside the folders where game settings normally live
WARN_NOT_DISCOVER_CANDIDATE: Auto-detection did not suggest this file
DISCOVER_ADD_CONFIDENT: Add all {n} game(s) whose config file was found
DISCOVER_BADGE_AMBIGUOUS: {n} candidate(s) — pick the right one yourself
DISCOVER_TIER3: Name only looks like a settings file
DISCOVER_NONE_FOUND: There are no games to show in the auto-detection results. Auto-detection only checks inside Proton prefixes (…/steamapps/compatdata/<appid>/pfx/…). Native Linux games keep their settings files outside prefixes, so they cannot currently be registered, including with the button below. If a Proton game was not detected, use the button below to pick its config file inside that game's prefix. Otherwise, check that the game has been run at least once.
DISCOVER_NONE_UNREGISTERED: Every detected game is already registered
DISCOVER_WARN_TITLE: Is this the right file for {name}?
DISCOVER_WARN_BODY: Not registered yet. Auto-detection would not have suggested this file. Nothing has been written anywhere — cancel and nothing happens.
DISCOVER_MANUAL_NO_APPID: That file is not inside a game's Proton prefix (…/steamapps/compatdata/<number>/pfx/…), so there is no way to tell which game it belongs to. Nothing was registered. Files outside a prefix — including the settings of native Linux games — cannot be registered.
DISCOVER_NO_LIBRARY: Could not find a Steam library folder to start from — try [Scan again], then this button again
DISCOVER_WARN_MODAL_FAILED: Could not show the confirmation — nothing was registered. Try picking the file again.
DISCOVER_EXCLUDED_HINT: These are games you unregistered in this plugin. They no longer appear in the automatic detection list. [Put back] makes a game show up as a candidate again (when it is installed and has a config file).
DISCOVER_INCLUDED_NOTE: {name} is no longer excluded — add it from the detection list under [Back]. If it does not show up there, you can register it with [Pick a file…].
DISCOVER_INCLUDE_FAILED: Could not put this game back ({code})
DISCOVER_PICK_FILE_DESC: Pick the game's graphics config file yourself (usually inside …/compatdata/<number>/pfx/…).
DISCOVER_ADDED_HAS_BACKUPS: Added “{name}” — {n} earlier backup(s) remain. Restore them from [Apply/save per game] → this game's › → [Restore backup].
MANAGE_KEEP_CONFIG: The game's own settings file is never touched.
MANAGE_MODAL_FAILED: Could not show the confirmation — nothing was deleted.
DELETE_CONFIRM_BODY: This removes the registration and the saved profiles for this game.
DELETE_CONFIRM_BACKUP: The profiles are copied to backups first, and the backups stay after unregistering (this game has {n} backup(s) right now).
RESET_ZONE_BODY: Full reset — deletes {n} registration(s) and every saved profile.
RESET_HINT: Backup folders remain, but older backups may be pushed out while profile data is moved. The original game settings files are not touched.
BACKUP_LIST_HINT: Each row says where it goes back into — profile backups go into that profile, the rest go into the game's settings file.
BACKUP_KIND_DISK: Automatic backup taken just before an apply or restore (the game's settings file)
RESTORE_CONFIRM_BODY: The game's settings file will be overwritten with the backup from {stamp}.
RESTORE_CONFIRM_CURRENT: What gets overwritten (the settings file now): {state}
RESTORE_CONFIRM_BACKUP: The current content is kept as a backup before restoring — that uses one backup slot.
RESTORE_CONFIRM_SLOT_NOTE: Your saved profiles are not changed — only the settings file is rewritten.
RESTORE_OK: Restored the settings file from the {stamp} backup
RESTORE_OK_MANUAL: Restored the game's settings file from the {stamp} backup. If you later apply a saved profile, the game's settings file will change to that profile's content. To keep the restored content as a profile, save it as a profile for this game.
RESTORE_ALREADY: The settings file already matches this backup — nothing was changed
RESTORE_FOLLOWUP_TITLE: Apply it to the game now as well?
RESTORE_FOLLOWUP_BODY: The restored content is only in the {profile} profile. Apply it to the game's settings file so the game runs with it.
APPLY_ALL_CONFIRM_TITLE: Apply the “{profile}” profile to your games?
APPLY_ALL_CONFIRM_BODY: Checks the state of {total} registered game(s) and applies the “{profile}” profile where it can be applied and would make a change.
APPLY_CONFIRM_MODAL_FAILED: Could not show the confirmation — nothing was applied.
MANAGE_NAMES_HINT: This changes only the name shown on screen. Saved profiles and backups stay exactly where they are.
NAME_EDIT_HINT: Leave it empty to go back to the default name ({fallback}). Up to {max} characters are stored.
NAME_EDIT_RESET_NOTE: Display name reset to the default
RESET_CONFIRM_NAMES: The {n} display name(s) you set will also go back to the defaults.
RESTORE_MODAL_FAILED: Could not show the confirmation — nothing was restored.
RESTORE_FOLLOWUP_MODAL_FAILED: The {profile} profile was restored. However the follow-up question could not be shown — press [Apply {profile}].
NAME_EDIT_MODAL_FAILED: Could not show the rename dialog. The name is unchanged.
RESTORE_CONFIRM_SLOT_ASK: The game's settings file is not changed. After restoring you will be asked whether to apply the restored content to the game as well.
FILTER_NO_PROFILE_ONLY: Show only games without a profile
FILTER_ALL_HAVE_PROFILES: Every game has both profiles — turn the filter off to see them all
GAMES_EXCLUDED_NOTE: Some game-detection exclusion records remain — the exclusion list is under “Excluded games” in [Detect games].
GAME_DETAIL_DIVERGED: Right now: different from every saved profile
PROFILES_IDENTICAL: By their saved records, both profiles hold the same content.
SAVE_GUIDE_DOCK: Set the game's graphics options for {dock}, close the game, then press [Save {dock} profile].
SAVE_GUIDE_INTERNAL: Set the game's graphics options for {internal}, close the game, then press [Save {internal} profile].
SAVE_DESC: Saves what is in the game's settings file right now into this profile
SAVE_DESC_RUNNING: This game is running — whatever is on disk right now is what gets saved (a game that rewrites on exit may end up with different values)
OPEN_BACKUPS_DESC: Puts a profile or the game's settings file back to earlier content when you saved the wrong thing or things got broken
UNREGISTER_GAME_DESC: Removes only this plugin's registration and its saved profiles (copied to backups first). The game's own settings file is never touched.
BACKUP_LIST_ORDER_HINT: Newest first — what was just pushed out is near the top
BACKUP_RING_HINT: As you keep applying and saving, the oldest backups drop off
BACKUP_LIST_FOLLOWUP_HINT: After a profile is restored you are asked whether to apply it to the game as well
DELETE_CONFIRM_REDISCOVER: Unregistering also excludes the game from automatic detection. To use it again, put it back from “Excluded games” in [Detect games] or pick its file yourself. If any backups remain, their content can be restored after the game is registered again.
RESET_LEFT_NOTE: {left} could not be deleted — running the reset again continues with what is left
RESET_CONFIRM_WARN: ⚠ Reset targets {games} registration record(s) and {profiles} profile record(s) the plugin can recognize for deletion. Profile data not included in these counts may also be deleted. Backup folders remain, but older backups may be pushed out while profile data is moved. To recover backup content, register the game again and then restore it.
RESET_CONFIRM_EXCLUDED: The detection-exclusion list is cleared as well ({n})
APPLY_CONFIRM_BODY: The game's settings file will be overwritten with the saved {profile} profile.
APPLY_CONFIRM_CURRENT: What gets overwritten (the game's settings file now): {state}
APPLY_CONFIRM_KEEP: The current content is kept as a backup — that uses one backup slot.
APPLY_CONFIRM_SAVE_HINT: To keep the current content, cancel and press [Save {profile} profile] first.
APPLY_OK: Changed the game's settings file to the {profile} profile.
APPLY_ALREADY: The game's settings file already matches the {profile} profile — nothing was changed.
SAVE_ALREADY: The {profile} profile already matches the game's settings file — nothing was saved.
WARN_SAVE_WHILE_RUNNING: Note: the game is running. Capturing now saves the settings file as it is on disk, not the values the game will write when it exits.
BACKUP_EVICT_SUMMARY: Going ahead deletes {n} older backup(s) across {games} game(s).
RESULT_STALE_NOTE: The action finished. However the screen could not be re-read, so it may still show the earlier state — press [Refresh].
GAME_DETAIL_STATUS_BOTH: Right now it matches both profiles
BACKUP_ROW_TARGET_DISK: Goes back into: the game's settings file
RESTORE_CONFIRM_TITLE_PROFILE: Restore the {profile} profile from this backup?
RESTORE_CONFIRM_BODY_PROFILE: The content saved in the {profile} profile will be overwritten with the backup from {stamp}.
RESTORE_CONFIRM_CURRENT_PROFILE: What gets overwritten (the {profile} profile now): saved at {saved_at}
RESTORE_CONFIRM_SLOT_UNREADABLE: This profile's saved record is damaged, so its current content cannot be copied to backups. If you restore, what is in the slot now cannot be brought back.
RESTORE_CONFIRM_KEEP_CONFIG: The game's settings file is not changed.
RESTORE_OK_PROFILE: Restored the {profile} profile from the {stamp} backup
RESTORE_ALREADY_PROFILE: The {profile} profile already matches this backup — nothing was changed
RESULT_MODAL_FAILED: (the result window could not be shown, so it is written here)
